title: Investigation of polymer blend formulation and homogenization dynamics in the development of biodegradable, hydrophobic, and heat-resistant seaweed-based bioplastic straws
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00344J, Paper

Wahyu Ramadhan, Joko Santoso, Uju, Rahadiyan Garuda Langit Dewangga, Mario Natanael, Muhammad Aldy Luthfiansyah, Adinda Yulya Rachmawati, Zacky Arivaie Santosa
Seaweed-based bioplastic straws produced by low-speed homogenization show improved water resistance, hydrophobicity, and biodegradability, offering a sustainable alternative to commercial paper straws.
